repos_data.description: Browser automation framework and MCP server for web-scraping and testing. CDP Mode makes Chrome stealthy for bypassing bot-detection.
Stealth browser for AI agents — real Chrome over raw CDP, no Playwright/Puppeteer. TypeScript + MCP-native. Passes sannysoft 57/57, bypasses Cloudflare.

Stealth browser automation for AI agents — unattended, headless, N parallel persistent logged-in Chromes. One MCP server + CLI, credential vault with TOTP/IMAP 2FA, vision clicking, prompt-injection scanning. Self-hosted, real Chrome. 1,250 tests.
